notes.title: Added Cards To The Game!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, big announcement here!

We're always striving to make our game stand out, so we've incorporated deck-building elements into the gameplay! 
We've added over 320 cards. Build your decks in advance, then pick up cards in-game to customize your weapons, enhance your abilities, or even perform actions like advancing the game time!

Here are the 4 types of cards:

 Power-up Cards: Empower the hero and influence all weapons.
 Weapon Cards: Used to unlock the weapons to battle against aliens.
 Equipment Cards: Attach them to your weapons to personalize them.
 Action Cards: Execute actions such as reducing enemy health, collecting money, and more.

But that's not all! The game also uses cards to challenge you by introducing maluses and altering the map layout. So watch out!

Additional features include:

 In-game events like meteors, monster eggs, and more. Play to find out :)
 Improved weapon and alien balance.
 An epic final boss.
 Numerous bug fixes.

We're eager to hear your thoughts on these updates.
Traviteam

notes.title: Exciting New Update: Player-Driven Enhancements are Here!
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

We are absolutely thrilled to announce our latest game update. 

Over the past few days, we've been gathering your valuable feedback and have been hard at work incorporating those changes to improve the overall gameplay experience.

Here's what you can expect in this new update:

Character Specializations:  Now, each character has unique abilities and features. Choosing one matters! We've added special weapons and power-ups exclusive to each character, some you will have from the start, while others you'll have to unlock as you progress.

Dynamic Maps:  The environments are now more dynamic with an abundance of objects scattered around. But be cautious, they could be dangerous!

New Weapons: Unleash chaos on aliens with our newly added weapons - lightning blast, airbombs, ramming drones, missiles, electric turrets, and more!

New Monsters: Brace yourselves for some fresh challenges as we've introduced new monsters in the game.

Enhanced Gameplay: We've ironed out some kinks and smoothened the gameplay experience thanks to the feedbacks we received.

While we're excited about these updates, we're not stopping here. We still want to hear from you! 

As always, we invite you to join our Discord server. Let's create an even better gaming experience, together!

Happy gaming and enjoy the new updates!

notes.title: Demo Update v0.012
notes.content:
Demo Update 0.012

     Added player hit sound and death animation: We added a sound when hit and also a death animation.
     Introducing crystal enemies: We introduced crystal enemies that have a low chance of dropping valuable crystals. 
     Rebalanced prices in the shop: We've adjusted the prices of various items in the shop.
     Discover mysterious ruins on the map: Explore the depths of the game world as random ruins emerge in unexpected locations. Unlocking relics within these ruins will require tenacity and skill!
     New Challenges: certain situations will demand you to face enemies head-on instead of retreating! 
     Enhanced notifications: Keep your eyes open! You'll now receive notifications when crystals or ruins appear on the map, ensuring that no valuable opportunities slip through your fingers.


We hope these changes improve your gaming experience and make it even more enjoyable. Join our Discord server to connect with fellow players and actively participate in shaping the game's development.

Stay tuned for more updates, exciting features, and improvements to come!

notes.title: Demo Update v0.011
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the first demo update for our game, based on the valuable feedback we've collected from you! 

Demo Update 0.011 (4 July 2023)

 Added 1.5 seconds of invulnerability when hit: Now, when you take damage, you'll have a brief moment of invincibility to strategize and react.
 Enemies no longer damage you immediately upon spawning: We've adjusted the game mechanics to prevent enemies from instantly damaging you when they appear, giving you a fair chance to engage them.
 Reduced 1 life for every character: To balance the gameplay, we have made the game a bit more challenging by reducing the number of lives for each character.
 Increased money gains: we've increased the amount of money you gain both when dying and when collecting it on the map.
 Crystal rocks enhancements: To provide more opportunities for progression in the metagame, crystal rocks will now spawn earlier. Additionally, we've reduced the life of crystal rocks, making them easier to destroy.
 Fixed localization issues

We hope these changes improve your gaming experience and make it even more enjoyable. Join our Discord server to connect with fellow players and actively participate in shaping the game's development.

Stay tuned for more updates, exciting features, and improvements to come!
